claims.answer: Local agents run on the user Mac, either under Seatbelt or in a local Linux micro-VM. The maintainer documents fletch-host serve on a user-controlled Mac or Linux machine that remains on, driven from a paired desktop or phone. Current source docs separately describe a provider-hosted runner. Remote clients lack a live terminal in the dated gap list. Local agents stop when the app quits; closing its window only hides it. A separately running fletch-host can outlive its remote clients on a machine left on.

sources.locator: module contract lines 1-12; ManagedSession::spawn command construction lines 89-94
sources.finding: The pinned persistent runner launches the Claude coding CLI with --print, stream-json input/output and the stdio permission protocol, then spawns the specified command in the session working directory. The separate claude.rs adapter documents --session-id/--resume transcript integration.

sources.finding: Builds the Codex coding CLI exec/resume command with JSON events and session arguments.

sources.finding: Builds the Cursor Agent CLI print command with stream-json, force/trust and optional resume arguments.

sources.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/opencode.rs
sources.finding: Builds the OpenCode CLI run command with JSON output and session arguments.

sources.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/pi.rs
sources.finding: Builds the Pi coding CLI print command with JSON mode and a persistent session path. The dated maintainer discussion marks Pi experimental.

sources.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/antigravity.rs
sources.finding: Builds the Antigravity coding CLI print/conversation command. The dated maintainer discussion marks this integration experimental.

sources.title: Fletch: docs/isolation.md
sources.locator: The model in one paragraph; engines; engine_for_spawn; retired engine restriction
sources.finding: Each agent uses a full shared-object clone. Seatbelt confines writes but leaves host reads/network open; the Linux micro-VM has different boundaries. Docker and Podman engines are retired and stamped workspaces refuse to run.

sources.title: Fletch: src/components/RightPanel/Code/DiffView.tsx
sources.locator: useFileDiff lines 32-53; DiffBody and DiffLineRow lines 81-160
sources.finding: The accessible Code/Git panel renderer parses a fetched unified diff and displays hunk headers, old/new line numbers, addition/deletion sigils and highlighted code-line text.

sources.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/telemetry.rs
sources.locator: init, track, set_enabled; configured API key and host; feedback exception
sources.finding: Configured builds send usage events to PostHog; track honors the persisted flag and the in-app setting updates it. User-submitted feedback uses the same transport but deliberately bypasses that usage flag.

sources.title: Fletch: src-tauri/src/lib.rs
sources.finding: Usage analytics is enabled unless the saved flag is false. Sentry crash/error reporting in DSN-configured builds is initialized independently of that flag. The source calls crash reporting app health; this catalog counts diagnostics as ADE telemetry.

sources.title: Fletch: src/components/SettingsScreen/GeneralPane.tsx
sources.finding: Settings exposes a Usage analytics toggle. It does not establish a control that stops the independently initialized Sentry crash path.

sources.title: Fletch: docs/cloud-runner-setup.md
sources.locator: opening paragraphs and On the runner disk; Creating it
sources.finding: Current source documentation describes fletch-host running on the user cloud-provider machine without the laptop, with paired devices connecting through the relay. Distribution parity was not checked.
